description: Abemaciclib with an aromatase inhibitor is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating locally advanced or metastatic, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer as first endocrine-based therapy in adults. Abemaciclib is recommended only if the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
